collection.title: VW Caravelle T6 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Caravelle T6 2015 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this Caravelle, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
